name: Taiwan Web Designs Quote Popup
author: Ernie Ramirez

sections.description:
Taiwan Web Designs Quote Popup is the perfect solution for businesses looking to increase conversions and capture more leads. With its engaging multi-step design, customizable appearance, and built-in lead management, this plugin makes it easy to collect quotes and inquiries from your website visitors.

Key Features

  • Multi-step form flow that keeps users engaged
  • Fully customizable colors, text, and button position
  • Email notifications for new submissions
  • Lead management dashboard in WordPress admin
  • CSV export for email marketing platforms
  • Mobile responsive design
  • Easy 5-minute installation
  • Secure with WordPress security best practices
  • Professional appearance on any website

Perfect For

  • Web design agencies
  • Freelancers and consultants
  • Service-based businesses
  • E-commerce stores
  • Real estate agents
  • Marketing agencies
  • Any business that needs to capture leads

How It Works

  1. User clicks the floating button on your site
  2. Beautiful popup opens with your custom questions
  3. User answers questions in a multi-step flow
  4. Final step collects contact information
  5. You receive email notification
  6. All data is saved in your WordPress dashboard

What Makes This Different?

Unlike other contact forms that ask everything on one page, Quote Form Popup uses a multi-step approach that feels more like a conversation. This significantly increases completion rates and gives you better quality leads.

CSV Export

Export your leads in two formats:

  • All Data Export – Complete information including all question answers
  • Email List Only – Just names and emails for email marketing platforms

Works perfectly with Mailchimp, Constant Contact, AWeber, and any email marketing platform that accepts CSV files.

Support

For support, please contact: support@taiwanwebhosting.com

We typically respond within 24-48 business hours.

When contacting support, please include:
* WordPress version
* PHP version
* Active theme name
* Description of the issue
* Any error messages

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores form submissions in your WordPress database. The following data is collected when users submit the form:

  • Name, email, and phone number (provided by user)
  • Answers to your custom questions
  • Submission date and time
  • IP address (for spam prevention)

No data is sent to external servers. All data remains on your WordPress installation under your control.

Developer

Developed by: Ernie Ramirez / Taiwan Web Designs
Website: https://taiwanwebdesigns.com
Support: support@taiwanwebhosting.com

We specialize in custom WordPress solutions for businesses worldwide.

Third-Party Services

This plugin does not connect to any third-party services or external APIs. All data is processed and stored locally on your WordPress installation.

Credits

  • Developed by Ernie Ramirez
  • Taiwan Web Designs – https://taiwanwebdesigns.com
  • Support: support@taiwanwebhosting.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Quote Form Popup”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Quote Form in your admin menu to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to WordPress admin
  3. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to Quote Form → Settings to configure

After Installation

  1. Go to Quote Form → Settings
  2. Customize your button text and colors
  3. Edit the question steps to match your needs
  4. Enter your email address for notifications
  5. Click Save All Settings
  6. Visit your website and test the popup
sections.faq:
How do I customize the questions?

Go to Quote Form → Settings in your WordPress admin. You can edit existing steps, add new steps, or delete steps. Each step can have a title, subtitle, question, and multiple answer options.

How do I change the button position?

In Quote Form → Settings, look for “Button Position” under “Button Settings”. You can choose from bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, or top-left.

Where are form submissions stored?

All submissions are automatically saved in your WordPress database. View them anytime at Quote Form → Submissions.

Can I export my leads?

Yes! Two export options: (1) Export all data with questions and answers for analysis, or (2) Export email list only for importing into email marketing platforms.

Is the popup mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The popup is fully responsive and works beautifully on all devices.

Does this work with page builders?

Yes, it works with all page builders including Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and others. The button appears site-wide automatically.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes! You can customize the button background color, button text color, and primary accent color to match your brand.

How many steps can I have?

You can have as many steps as you want, but we recommend 3-5 steps for best conversion rates.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely! All submissions are stored in YOUR WordPress database – no third-party services involved. We use WordPress security best practices including nonce verification, data sanitization, and XSS prevention.

Do I need technical skills?

No! If you can install a WordPress plugin and change text fields, you can use Quote Form Popup. It’s designed to be simple.
